rationale: The question is what an overlapping body of reviews shows, which an umbrella review answers: appraise each review with AMSTAR 2, build an overlap matrix, prefer the most recent high-quality review per outcome, and return to primary studies only where reviews disagree. The retrieved evidence shows reduced inappropriate orders (c1) and lumbar orders without harm in the trials that looked (c2), and that overlap and low review quality make simple counting misleading (c3).
alternatives: New systematic review and pooled analysis of primary studies (refused: repeats existing pooling of the same studies)
Rapid review of the most recent review only (refused: ignores disagreement and quality)
Local before-after evaluation after purchase (deferred: follows procurement)
whyNotMoreComplex: Re-pooling primary studies would take more than the available time and add little where recent reviews exist.

decision.statement: Conduct an umbrella review of reviews of point-of-order imaging decision support, focused on low back pain, with AMSTAR 2 appraisal and an overlap matrix, reporting to the procurement board by March 2027.
decision.question: What evidence synthesis should inform the specification for imaging decision support?

criteria.text: Reviews report reductions in inappropriate and lumbar imaging orders.
Overlap and low review quality make an appraised overview necessary.
A recent high-quality overview of the same question already exists.

gates.requirement: Information specialist time for the search
gates.evidence: Library allocation LIB-2026-41 for 10 working days from October 2026, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Procurement board agreement to wait for the review
gates.evidence: Board minute PB-2026-09-17-3, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: New pooled analysis of primary studies
Rapid review of the latest review
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c3 from retrieved records; the unverified landmark lead is not cited.

summary: Umbrella review recommended; decision rests on three ledger claims; gates met.
